desc:
[IN NEW SERVERS] PC: HOLD F TO CHARGE!

⚔️ Hack, slash, and slice objects IN HALF!

Start small and work your way up to massive trees and mountains. Watch your blade cut straight through them!

💪 Gain Power with every slash
🗡️ Unlock new swords and upgrades
🏆 Climb the global leaderboards  
⭐ Premium: +10% Power gain
🤝 Friends: +5% Power gain for every friend in your server

I made this because I wanted a game where you could actually slice objects in half. I hope you enjoy playing it as much as I’ve enjoyed making it!

👍 Enjoying the game? Leave a like to support future updates!


Recent UPDATES:

10/21: MANY more sections and crescents, added more treadmills, bug and performance fixes, enjoy!

10/19: Added a new boss, changed their health structures, and added more titles for players! 

10/17: Great Swords and Titles! New sword class that deals more damage and power, and titles for top 100 leaderboards that also help with progression!



Released October 11, 2026
